prompt:
Analyze this Performance page UX and provide specific design improvements:

CURRENT PERFORMANCE PAGE LAYOUT:
- Static page with hardcoded metrics (CPU: 67%, Memory: 82%, Disk I/O: 45%, Network: 23%)
- Basic grid layout with 4 metric cards
- Simple page header with title and description
- No visualizations or charts
- No interactivity or real-time updates
- No historical data or trends

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
- Metric cards with percentage values
- Basic CSS grid layout
- Static page header
- No charts or graphs
- No progress indicators or animations

UX ISSUES TO IMPROVE:
- Static data with no real-time updates
- No visualizations or performance trends
- No historical data or performance history
- No performance alerts or recommendations
- No system optimization suggestions
- Missing mobile optimization and touch interactions
- No detailed performance breakdown or drill-down options

Provide 3-4 specific UX design improvements focusing on:
1. Real-time performance monitoring and visualization
2. Interactive charts and performance trends
3. Performance alerts and optimization suggestions
4. Mobile experience and touch interactions
5. Historical data and performance analytics

Focus on practical, implementable solutions with specific examples.
